name: Email → PDF
description: Takes an email from "Mail dropped in a folder" and lists the files to store: Email.pdf (the email rendered by Outlook) and its attachments in their original format. Inline images stay inside Email.pdf; cloud links are skipped and listed. Files are references the storing node fetches at upload time, so no file content passes through the run. Output: {folder_name, files, skipped, source}.
